facts.fact: ST Digital inaugurated its data centre in the VITIB free zone, Grand-Bassam, on 2 October 2025, built in eight months on 4,000 m2 and offered as a cloud to the Ivorian market.
The datasheet of ST Digital's Grand-Bassam data centre states Tier 3 level, compliant with TIA-942 (stated by the operator).

note: Operator-by-operator count of about 20 data centres (MTN, Orange, VIPNET, MainOne, New Digital Africa, Raxio) does not say which are for hire, so no further fact.
